design_brief.problem_statement: Original exact c14 EG1 sends three reliable operations and a single unreliable movement; archived failures contain only the three operations. A later run passed focused EG1 and failed the same test in full regression.
design_brief.current_behavior: Missing INPUT or SNAPSHOT leaves three workers waiting until their unchanged 60000ms deadline. No proven production defect has been established.
design_brief.desired_behavior: A causally justified fixture matches its declared network preconditions and tests real gateway/sim equivalence without weakening movement, four unique operations, checksums, identity isolation or detach assertions.
alternatives_considered: Instrument the failed path and run a bounded discriminator campaign
Explicitly establish a no-adaptive-drop loopback fixture if ENet throttling is demonstrated
Implement bounded semantic replay only if fixture ownership and existing duplicate contracts justify it
Reject blind timeout increases, reliable INPUT remapping and rerun-until-green
design_brief.selected_design: Diagnosis first. Record transport/queue facts and a controlled falsifier. Select the smallest test-owned correction only after evidence; production transport/channel policy remains read-only.
design_brief.why_selected: The L2 test requires a fixed four-operation, one-shot exchange, while canonical INPUT/SNAPSHOT use unreliable application-sequenced transport. Test preconditions and actual loss must be separated from product authority.
non_goals: Claim impaired-network acceptance from loss-free loopback
expected_risks: No-drop setup may conceal a different defect unless causally tested
A new full-regression defect may need another bounded Work Order
Independent role environment may be unavailable

Unchanged focused assertions and sibling network tests
